title: At the doctor's
summary: A patient with a headache sees a doctor.

sentences.en: Hello, what seems to be the problem?

sentences.zh: 医生，我头疼，身体也很累。
sentences.en: Doctor, I have a headache and I feel very tired.
How long have you had the headache?

sentences.zh: 两天了。因为头疼，所以我昨天没去上班。
sentences.en: Two days. Because of the headache, I didn't go to work yesterday.
How many hours do you sleep a day?

sentences.zh: 最近工作很忙，每天只睡五个小时。
sentences.en: Work has been busy; I only sleep five hours a day.

sentences.zh: 你是因为太累了。这几天别工作了，在家休息吧。
sentences.en: It's because you're too tired. Don't work for the next few days; rest at home.
Do I need to take medicine?

sentences.zh: 吃一点儿药，每天吃两次。多喝水，早一点儿睡觉。
sentences.en: Take a little medicine, twice a day. Drink lots of water and go to bed a bit earlier.

questions.prompt: How long has David had a headache?
why: Five hours is how long he sleeps.

questions.prompt: Why does the doctor think he has a headache?
why: He says he has no fever: 不发烧.

questions.prompt: How often should he take the medicine?
why: Five is the hours he sleeps.

questions.prompt: What does the doctor tell him NOT to do?
why: She tells him to drink lots of water.
She tells him to go to bed early.
